name: A Tenth
overview: The biblical concept of a tenth, or tithe, is presented as a holy portion dedicated to the LORD, encompassing a tenth of produce, livestock, and possessions. From Abraham's giving of tithes after victory (Genesis 14:20) to Jacob's vow to offer a tenth of all he receives (Genesis 28:22), Scripture establishes tithing as an act of worship and acknowledgment of God's provision. The Levitical laws further emphasize the sanctity of the tithe, designating it as holy to the LORD (Leviticus 27:30, 32) and assigning it as an inheritance to the Levites for their service in the tabernacle (Numbers 18:21). Additionally, the Levites were instructed to offer a tenth of their received tithes back to the LORD, underscoring a continual cycle of dedication and service (Numbers 18:26).
